checks.rule: Composite DTM 1m covers approximately 99 percent of England
DTM removes surface objects rather than retaining DSM objects
Composite is derived from Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme
Newest and best-resolution survey is selected where repeats exist
Bilinear interpolation is used where source data is resampled
Location-specific survey index metadata must be preserved
WMS/WCS/WMTS services exist for composite DTM
OGC API Features metadata service is available
Composite value cannot be promoted without actual raster sampling and provenance readback
